# DAAS - Document Approval & Automation System

> DAAS is an enterprise document processing, workflow approval management, and audit verification platform.

## Documentation and Resources

- [DAAS Application Overview](/) : Main application dashboard and document processing interface
- [API Documentation](/api/docs) : OpenAPI interactive documentation for backend endpoints
- [Workflows & Approval Routing](/workflows) : Business rules, multistage approvals, and SLA tracking
- [Audit & Compliance](/audit) : Comprehensive tamper-evident activity logs and verification history
